recheckOpen.resolvedReasonNotReadable: GET /ops/health lists open alerts only and no route returns alert.resolved_reason for an operator's alert, so "cleared" is read as the alert leaving the open list on the next watchdog run. The code sets the reason: recovered with "<display> at <park> is calling again" (screen-presence.ts evaluateDisplay), and "no longer paired" for a revoked display (displayConditions).

findingPairingRace.what: The 771b warning was first raised 2 seconds after pairing, before the display had called once.

evidence.healthDetailAt1125: ZZ TEST 771b display (customer display at ZZ TEST SCRUM-771b till) · recovered and broke again 1×

findingPairingRace.why: claimDisplay (display.ts) sets pairedAt but not lastSeenAt; screenPresence treats a null lastSeenAt as offline; evaluateDisplay raises it while the park is open ("has not called since it was paired"). A watchdog run that lands between the claim and the display's first call (here 04:21:36.5 to 04:21:43.6) raises it, delivers it as opened, and the next run closes it as recovered.
findingPairingRace.consequence: The genuine outage at 04:25:38 came inside ALERT_FLAP_WINDOW_S (300 s) of that close, so raiseAlert reopened the same row as a flap (Health: "recovered and broke again 1×"), and by the code (raiseAlert, the watchdog open in jobs.ts) a reopen is not delivered: Health showed it, nobody was told. Deliveries are not readable from the api; this part is from the code. The 771c display (claimed at 04:21:52.9, first call 04:22:00, no watchdog run in between) is the clean case: raised once at 04:25:38, delivered as a new alert.

Console > Health in opening hours: the open warning raised by the watchdog for the quiet ZZ TEST 771b display (its alert key display.offline:<credential id>), in the lane's own words. The 771c display's alert, raised the same way, is beside it. Who took any alert is masked.

The ZZ TEST 771b display page opened again in a new browser with the same stored pairing (no re-pairing): Console > Devices > Paired screens reads Online again. The 771c display, still closed, reads Offline. The park's display label is masked.

Console > Health after the ZZ TEST 771b display called again: its warning is no longer among the open alerts (the watchdog closed it; the api does not show a closed alert's reason, which the code sets to recovered with the words "... is calling again"). The 771c display, still quiet, keeps its open warning. Who took any alert is masked.

Console > Health after the ZZ TEST 771c display was revoked while its warning stood open: the next watchdog run closed it, so neither ZZ TEST display has an open alert (the code closes a revoked display's alert as "no longer paired"; the api does not show a closed alert's reason).
